comment: Liquid Dynamics projectiles. cd_tissue is the drag coefficient of the round in soft-tissue simulant (10% ballistic gelatin) along its path, F = 1/2 rho Cd A v^2, for a round that does not yaw or expand. glass_impactor names the same round in the Glass Dynamics library so a host can hand pane strikes to that engine. Shot loads fire `pellets` identical pellets with an rms angular spread and a shot string; each pellet is its own round.

projectiles.name: 9 mm FMJ
projectiles.description: 124 grain full metal jacket from a pistol.

provenance.diameter_mm: published: C.I.P. 9 mm Luger bullet 9.01 mm
provenance.speed_ms: published: 124 gr FMJ from a 4 in barrel, 350-370 m/s (manufacturers' tables)
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: non-yawing round-nose bullet in gelatin, 0.25-0.35 (Peters, J. Trauma 1990; Sturdivan 1978 drag fits)

provenance.speed_ms: published: 240 gr from a 6 in barrel, ~440 m/s
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: flat meplat, more drag than round nose

projectiles.name: 7.62 x 51 mm ball
projectiles.description: 147 grain M80 ball from a rifle.

provenance.speed_ms: published: M80 from a 22 in barrel, ~840 m/s
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: spitzer before it yaws; the yaw that real rifle rounds develop after 10-20 cm of tissue is not modelled

projectiles.name: .50 BMG ball
projectiles.description: 12.7 x 99 mm heavy machine-gun round: a 708 grain full metal jacket bullet.

provenance.mass_g: published: 708 gr match/ball bullet = 45.9 g (as in Glass Dynamics' bmg_50)
provenance.speed_ms: published: UL 752 Level 10, 856-942 m/s; 900 as in Glass Dynamics
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: as the 7.62 mm spitzer before it yaws; yaw and break-up in tissue are not modelled

projectiles.name: 12-gauge 00 buckshot
projectiles.description: A 2-3/4 in 12-gauge shell of nine 8.4 mm lead balls, cylinder bore.

provenance.mass_g: published: 00 buck pellet 0.33 in (8.38 mm), 53.8 gr (3.49 g); 9 per 2-3/4 in 12-gauge shell
provenance.speed_ms: published: 1,325 ft/s (404 m/s) muzzle for standard 00 buck loads; about 395 m/s a few metres out
provenance.cd_tissue: estimated: a sphere in gelatin; with the dummy's Poncelet resistance a pellet penetrates 0.33 m (FBI-protocol tests of 00 buck report 0.35-0.45 m)
provenance.glass_impactor: gameplay: one pellet of Glass Dynamics' buckshot_00 (the host fires each pellet on its own)
provenance.pellets: published: nine pellets in a standard 2-3/4 in 00 buck shell
provenance.spread_mrad: estimated: a cylinder-bore pattern of about 1 in per yard (as Glass Dynamics' buckshot_00)
provenance.shot_string_m: estimated: shot string of a few tens of centimetres at short range (as Glass Dynamics)
